label: Lazard Technology Partners v. QinetiQ (Cyveillance) — 'up to $40 million if revenues reached a certain level'
provenance: PUBLIC RECORD. Lazard Tech. Partners, LLC v. QinetiQ N. Am. Operations LLC, No. 464,2014 (Del. Apr. 23, 2015). The opinion describes a $40 million payment at closing plus 'up to another $40 million if the company's revenues reached a certain level', and states that when the earn-out period ended the revenues had not reached the level required, so no earn-out was generated. The level itself and the actual revenues are not in the opinion.

deal.metricName: Cyveillance revenue over the earn-out period

settled.note: No earn-out was paid: the opinion states the revenues did not reach the required level.
